**Date:** 07/11/2026

## Agenda

- Recap quiz on Session 1
- 2.1  Finding the evidence: Boolean logic, MeSH, search blocks, live PubMed demo
- 2.2  Managing and citing: Zotero demo, citation styles, paraphrasing, grey literature
- Break
- 2.3  Reading a paper in 15 minutes and 2.4 from literature to introduction
- Proposal builder 2: your own search, 5 references, problem statement, working title

## Timetable

| Start | Clock* | Min | Segment |
|:----|:----|---:|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0:00 | 19:30 | 10 | Recap quiz |

## Before this session

- Your PICO question and your synonym list (Session 1 homework).
- A second browser tab for the PubMed search during the demo; Zotero and its Word plug-in installed (required).

## After this session (homework)

- **Your proposal:** find your five key references and write the problem statement. This completes Proposal Part 1, with a working title and keywords.
- Read one paper for your topic with the 15-minute routine and fill its row in the literature matrix.
- **Everyone:** read the abstract of [Paper 2](papers.qmd) (Hyun 2023) with the Exercise 3 grid.
- **Optional:** look up Paper 1's registration (NCT04947904) on ClinicalTrials.gov.
